Your Role
Warner Bros. Discovery Global Experiences is seeking a highly analytical and commercially minded Manager, Growth Insights & Performance to serve as the central source of truth for performance across the Americas portfolio, including owned and operated experiences, retail, new openings and priority licensed partners.

The Manager will aggregate and interpret ticket sales, attendance, revenue, booking pace, guest behavior and marketing performance; establish consistent metrics and reporting requirements; and turn insight into clear actions that improve demand, conversion, spend and repeat visitation. This role will own the weekly Growth War Room and partner closely with Marketing, Finance, Operations, Technology, Research and external partners to identify risks, close performance gaps and capture growth opportunities.

The ideal candidate combines exceptional analytical rigor and data integrity with practical business judgment, strong communication skills and the ability to influence decisions across a complex stakeholder environment

Your Role Accountabilities
- Establish and maintain a timely, trusted view of ticket sales, attendance, revenue, booking pace, conversion, average order value, per-capita spend, retail performance and marketing effectiveness across relevant Americas businesses and partners.
- Define the business questions, KPI hierarchy, data definitions, source-of-truth rules and reporting requirements needed to monitor performance consistently across experiences, retail and priority partners.
- Develop and deliver daily, weekly, monthly and seasonal performance reporting; identify meaningful trends, root causes, emerging risks and actionable opportunities.
- Segment performance by experience, product, audience, channel, geography, visit date, promotion and customer cohort to surface drivers of growth or underperformance.
- Own or coordinate recurring attendance, ticket-sales and revenue pacing views and forecast inputs, in partnership with Finance, commercial and operational stakeholders.
- Analyze historical demand, advance bookings, seasonality, local versus tourist visitation, market conditions, promotions, product mix and operational capacity to inform scenario planning.
- Quantify gaps to plan, evaluate likely commercial impact and recommend actions across media, CRM, offers, partnerships, pricing inputs and operational availability.

- Assess new launches, seasonal activations, upsell opportunities, repeat visitation and retail initiatives to support prioritization and stronger business cases.
- Lead the weekly cross-functional Growth War Room, bringing together Marketing, Finance, Operations, Technology, Research and relevant partner teams around actuals versus forecast, drivers, risks and opportunities.
- Translate analysis into specific recommended actions, assign owners and timelines, document decisions, and track follow-through and commercial results.
- Prepare concise executive-ready performance updates and business reviews that connect leading indicators, customer behavior and marketing activity to financial outcomes.

- Support annual planning, budget discussions and in-season trade-offs with objective analysis and clear recommendations
- Develop a consistent measurement framework across awareness, engagement, conversion, upsell and repeat visitation, with standardized conversion definitions and shared reporting across channels.
- Partner with Marketing, agency teams and Technology to improve campaign tagging, attribution, website funnel visibility, abandonment reporting and cross-channel performance measurement.
- Evaluate channel effectiveness, audience performance, customer acquisition cost, return on ad spend, incrementality where feasible and the contribution of WBD first-party audiences and owned reach.

- Prioritize and assess A/B tests across creative, messages, offers, audience segments, landing pages and customer journeys; quantify learnings and recommend when to scale, change or stop.
- Serve as the business owner for performance-reporting requirements, partnering with Technology, Finance, Operations and external operators to prioritize dashboards, integrations and analytics capabilities.
- Validate reporting outputs, reconcile discrepancies between ticketing, web, media, CRM, finance and partner systems, and establish practical governance for data quality and shared definitions.
- Develop actionable guest and customer insights, including audience segments, acquisition patterns, visit frequency, purchase behavior and lifetime-value indicators.

- Ensure measurement approaches, first-party data use, tagging and any privacy-approved pixels or conversion APIs comply with WBD privacy, security and data-governance requirements.

Qualifications & Experience
- 5-8 years of relevant experience in business analytics, growth strategy, commercial performance, business intelligence, revenue management, marketing analytics or a related field.

WB Games is a leader in the games industry across all game platforms and mobile devices. Our diverse and inclusive workforce creates and brings to life the most beloved characters, franchises, heroes, and wizards in the world. We are fans of what we make and proud of what we do. We have studios and offices across the globe.

We produce hundreds of UA creative assets a month. We know what we spend and we know what we make. What we need is someone who owns the connection between the two.

As our Performance Marketing Analyst – Creatives, you will sit on Performance Marketing and own how we understand creative performance: the weekly rhythm of what is working and why, the reporting the team works from, and the recommendations that shape what we produce next, where spend goes, and how efficiently we scale.
The Daily

1. Insights and Weekly Reporting
- Run the weekly performance readout: what is working, why, and what it means for creative production priorities.
- Creative performance insights: Including creative performance by concept, hook, format, network, and geo; Winner rate; Fatigue curves.
- Creative ROI: spend and return attributable to individual creatives and concept
- Production efficiency: cost and cycle time per asset by production source (GenAI pod, playables, vendors), measured against the performance those assets deliver.
- Translate all of the above into recommendations that help inform what the team produces

2. Visualizations and Reporting Infrastructure
- Make performance data self-serve: visualizations and reporting that put answers where the team already works, so insight doesn't bottleneck on one person.
- Decide what belongs in a dashboard, what belongs in an explore, and what belongs in a recurring readout.
- Partner with central data and engineering teams on pipeline and warehouse dependencies.

3. Data Foundation and Hygiene
- Inform the governed definition of creative performance tiers: the thresholds, the minimum spend and impression floors, the lookback windows, and the review cadence for changing them.
- Build and monitor data quality checks. Surface discrepancies before they reach a slide.

The Essentials
- 3+ years in marketing, growth, or product analytics. Mobile UA experience strongly preferred.
- Strong SQL. Comfortable modeling data, not just querying it.
- Fluency with AI-assisted tooling (Claude, Gemini, Cursor) for analysis and automation.
- Hands on experience with a BI tool (Looker, Tableau, or similar), including building and maintaining explores
- Working knowledge of mobile attribution: MMP data (AppsFlyer, Adjust, Singular), SKAdNetwork and AdAttributionKit, network reporting discrepancies, and the limits of each.
- Fluency in UA metrics: CPI, IPM, CTR, ROAS, etc
- Ability to define a metric, defend the definition, and hold the line when someone wants a friendlier number.

The Nice to Haves
- Experience analyzing creative performance specifically, including creative tagging and metadata frameworks.
- Familiarity with GenAI creative production workflows.
- Experience in gaming, especially free to play or 4X strategy titles.
